# definitions_install

:::info[Typed specification]

Generated by the pinned `ess generate --kind docs` from [`ess`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/ess). Structural validation establishes consistency; behaviour, storage and cross-record predicates remain implementation obligations.

:::

What `connectors definitions install` reads and writes. Index is a connectors-definitions release's published index.json as this build reads it; Lock pins one installed release for one connectors configuration; CacheEntry is the read-only copy of that release's files, keyed by the SHA-256 of its index.json.

`connectors.definitions_install` is one of connectors's bounded contexts. [Back to the index](../index.md).

## Types

### `Asset`

`connectors.definitions_install.Asset` is a record of two fields:

- `name` — `String`
- `sha256` — `connectors.definitions_install.HexDigest`

### `CacheEntry`

`connectors.definitions_install.CacheEntry` is a record of two fields:

- `index_sha256` — `connectors.definitions_install.HexDigest`
- `index` — `connectors.definitions_install.Index`

### `Feature`

`connectors.definitions_install.Feature` is one of `embedded_text`, `query_fixed`, `query_folds` and `rate_limit_headers`.

### `HexDigest`

`connectors.definitions_install.HexDigest` wraps `String` and is not interchangeable with one: the whole value of naming it separately is the crossings the model then refuses. Its characters are drawn from `0123456789abcdef`.

### `Index`

`connectors.definitions_install.Index` is a record of six fields:

- `schema` — `connectors.definitions_install.IndexSchemaId`
- `tag` — `String`
- `commit` — `connectors.definitions_install.HexDigest`
- `features` — `List<String>`
- `asset` — `connectors.definitions_install.Asset`
- `files` — `List<connectors.definitions_install.IndexFile>`

### `IndexFile`

`connectors.definitions_install.IndexFile` is a record of three fields:

- `path` — `String`
- `sha256` — `connectors.definitions_install.HexDigest`
- `size` — `Integer`

### `IndexSchemaId`

`connectors.definitions_install.IndexSchemaId` is one of `urn:beyond10x:connectors-definitions-index:1`.

### `Lock`

`connectors.definitions_install.Lock` is a record of five fields:

- `format` — `connectors.definitions_install.LockFormat`
- `source` — `String`
- `tag` — `String`
- `commit` — `connectors.definitions_install.HexDigest`
- `index_sha256` — `connectors.definitions_install.HexDigest`

### `LockFormat`

`connectors.definitions_install.LockFormat` is one of `connectors-definitions-lock/1`.

Three of the types above are reached by nothing else in this system: `connectors.definitions_install.CacheEntry`, `connectors.definitions_install.Feature` and `connectors.definitions_install.Lock`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names them, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
